Hiryu Rin (Provisional License).name: Hiryu Rin (Provisional License)
Hiryu Rin (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Hiryu Rin, hero name Long Weizi, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course from China who holds a provisional hero license: 1-B took the exam at a different venue from 1-A, and the whole class passed. Black low braid, narrow eyes, a solid build; the U.A. uniform or his black-and-gold hero costume.
Speaking Style: Calm, brief and practical.
Combat Role: Armored capture-and-rescue support: scale cover for those behind him, measured volleys to pin a threat.
Under Pressure: Shields civilians first and acts on his license in an emergency.
Hiryu Rin (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer made the danger real; his answer is more discipline, not more noise. Motivation: Turn the license into real rescues with 1-B beside him. Connections: Neito Monoma, who keeps reminding 1-A that every 1-B student passed and two of theirs did not. Thread: What kind of hero a reliable, unshowy Quirk makes of him.
QUIRK: Scales: practiced armor and accurate volleys; still breakable, still limited.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license. All Might retired after Kamino.
personality: Protective: Puts his scales between danger and whoever is exposed.
Disciplined: Keeps his volleys measured when an exercise turns chaotic.
Methodical: Carries out his assigned role without improvising for show.
Speaking style: Calm, brief, practical; short calls, little small talk.
abilities: Scales: Practiced armor and accurate volleys that pin or disarm; heavy force still cracks the armor.
Shield line: Plates his arms and stands between a civilian and danger.
Provisional license: May act with his Quirk in an emergency; it does not make him a pro.
Chinese: Can calm and direct Chinese-speaking tourists in an emergency.
Fighting style: Shields the exposed behind his scales, pins the threat with measured volleys and lets the teammate best placed make the capture.
Hiryu Rin (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with black hair pulled back from his face into a low braid, narrow eyes with small dark irises, light skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Steady, quietly confident expression.
